title: Maa Raaito Illa Jamila
body:
Pucha Jab Yazeed (l.a) Ne Darbar E Shaam Mein,
Manzar Yeh Karbala Ka Tumhe Kis Tarha Laga,
Samjha Tha Woh Ke Zainab E Dilgeer (s.a) Royengi,
Lekin Ali (a.s) Beti Ne Jurrat Se Yeh Kaha,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Bint E Haider Ki Yahi Darbar Me Goonji Sada,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Warisaan E Haq Hain Hum Hi Waris E Quran Hain,
Waris E Deen E Khuda Hain Kul Ka Kul Imaan Hain,
Hashr Tak Pehchaan Hai Islam Ki Karbobala,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Thi Khabar Humko Madiney Se Chala Jab Qafela,
Jante Thy Imtehaan E Sabr Hai Rab Ki Reza,
Chal Raha Tha Yeh Nabi (s.a.w.w) Ke Daur Se Hi Silsila,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Mai Aqeela E Bani Hashim Hu Bint E Murtaza,
Meri Maadar Syeda (s.a) Hai Aur Nana Mustafa (s.a.w.w),
Tu Nijasat Ka Gharana Dekh Yeh Shajra Mera,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Tu Samjhta Hai Shaheedon Ka Lahoo Chup Jayega,
Shoor E Matam Har Jagha Duniya Ko Yeh Batlayega,
Maarqa Yeh Haq O Baatil Ka Hai Yeh Haq Ki Sada,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Teen Deen Bhuka O Pyaasa Aale Ahmad Ko Rakha,
Zulm Jo Bhi Ho Saka Tujhse Rawa Tune Kiya,
Ladke Jaan De Di Nahi Sar Tere Aage Jhuk Saka,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Sine Mein Barchhi Ka Phaal Akbar Ko Maara Bekhata,
Qasim O Asghar O Ghazi Pe Sitam Ki Imtehaa,
Dekh Kar Guzri Hu Laashon Ka Yeh Manzar Be Rida,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Hum Khuda Ke Deen Ki Hurmat Bachane Aaye Thy,
Jante Thy Karbala Mein Ghar Lutane Aaye Thy,
Shukr Hai Khaaliq Ka Jissne Surkhuru Humko Kiya,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Nauke Naize Pe Bahhatar(72) Sar Hai Sabse Motaabar,
Apne Fathaa Ka Yeh Elaan Kar Rahein Har Ek Nagar,
Karwaan Izzat Ka Hai Zillat Muqqadar Hai Tera,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
Sani E Zahra (s.a) Ke Dam Se Yeh Azadari Bapa,
Yeh Karam ALI DEEP Par Hai Bibi Zainab (s.a) Ki Dua,
Daur E Baatil Mein Jo Iss Ne Yeh Payam E Haq Likha,
Kya Samjhta Hai Yazeed E Asr Tu Karbobala...
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila,
Maa Ra'aito Illa Jamila... (2)
